_help: Where Public Writing comes from. A source with a 'url' and no 'only' list shows every post from that Substack. A source with an 'only' list shows just those posts (match by URL or title); typed-in title/date are used if the site can't be reached. A source with no 'url' is a list of articles on other sites. Optional per post: 'role' (e.g. Contributor) and 'outlet' (label shown on the card). 'exclude' hides posts by URL. Write ~~text~~ in a name to strike it through.
